data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.
神舟飞船 — 中文维基百科
Shenzhou 5 (2003-10-15) · Yang Liwei — first Chinese citizen in space; 14 orbits / 21 hours; made China the third nation with independent crewed spaceflight
Shenzhou 6 (2005-10-12) · Fei Junlong + Nie Haisheng — first two-person Chinese crew; 5 days / 76 orbits
Shenzhou 7 (2008-09-25) · Zhai + Liu + Jing — Zhai Zhigang: first Chinese EVA (22 min); deployed BX-1 nano-satellite
Shenzhou 9 (2012-06-16) · Jing + Liu Wang + Liu Yang — Liu Yang: first Chinese woman in space; first crewed dock with Tiangong-1
Shenzhou 11 (2016-10-17) · Jing + Chen Dong — 33-day mission to Tiangong-2; longest Chinese spaceflight at the time
Shenzhou 14 (2022-06-05) · Chen + Liu + Cai — oversaw Tiangong station assembly (Wentian + Mengtian modules)
Shenzhou 15 (2022-11-29) · Fei + Deng + Zhang — first Tiangong six-person handover (overlap with SZ-14)
Shenzhou 19 (2024-10-29 – 2025-04-30) · Cai + Song + Wang — completed 6-month Tiangong mission; Wang Haoze first female Chinese flight engineer
China’s crewed spacecraft, externally Soyuz-derived but enlarged. First crewed flight in 2003 (Shenzhou 5, Yang Liwei); now the standard ferry to Tiangong, with crew rotations every six months.
China's first Shenzhou orbital test — opened the path to crewed PRC spaceflight
China's crewed-spaceflight pad — every Shenzhou crew
China's next crew spacecraft, in development
ISS-era Soyuz; expanded crew height envelope
OV-105 — fifth Shuttle, built from spares to replace Challenger. First Hubble servicing STS-61 (1993); delivered Unity + Canadarm2
Soviet shuttle; one unmanned flight, never crewed
USSF reusable robotic spaceplane — multi-year classified orbital missions, the only US spaceplane operational after the Shuttle's retirement
Shenzhou 1 return capsule, flown on China's first Shenzhou test flight (1999)
